title: v2.1.115 Four Production-Critical Bug Fixes
description: v2.1.115 (released ~2026-04-19) contains four fixes affecting common workflows: (1) --resume regression: sessions created before v2.1.85 failing with 'tool_use ids were found without tool_result blocks'; (2) outside-root edit regression: Write/Edit/Read failing on files outside project root (e.g. ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md) when conditional skills or rules are configured — directly affects this workspace since CLAUDE.md files live outside project roots; (3) config write storm: unnecessary config disk writes on every skill invocation causing performance degradation; (4) --bare regression: --bare mode dropping MCP tools in interactive sessions and silently discarding enqueued messages.
relevance: HIGH — outside-root edit regression directly affects ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md editing patterns used by every session on this workspace. Should verify current Claude Code version is >= v2.1.115.
action: Version registry update only. Verify workspace is on v2.1.115+. No config changes needed.

evaluation.reasoning: Registry-update item: no configuration changes needed. Integration complexity = 100 (zero friction — pure registry documentation). Token efficiency neutral (50): fixes restore broken functionality, no direct token impact. Capability expansion (40): four regressions fixed — most impactful is outside-root edit regression which directly affected ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md patterns on this workspace; restoring functionality, not adding new capability. Maintenance = 100, community_validation = 100: official Anthropic changelog. Action: verify version is >=2.1.115 and add to registry.
